headline: Spend review time on the risky diff
lede: Group comments by risk, tests, and unanswered questions so reviewers start where it matters.
summary: A review desk for teams who want clearer pull requests, not more noise.
about: Code Review Assistant sorts a diff into risk, missing tests, and questions already answered. It does not replace the reviewer.
Sample reviews cover a payments change, a refactor, and a documentation-only patch.
